Nina: Scheduling a constrained infra apply tonight 23:45 UTC for release/2024.05. Scope: VPC route propagation fix, hub->spoke peering updates, and creation of a cross-account assume-role for billing. Change window 23:45-00:30 UTC.
Nina: Who can run the apply and write the short infra blurb for the release notes?
Carlos: I can run it. Will be on the call. What's the rollback criteria?
Jae: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure; sustained 6+ LB 5xx/min for 8m; or backend error rate > baseline +4% for 10m. Emergency abort if prod p95 > 250ms for 5m.
release-bot: Stubbed release note: "Infra: route propagation and peering updates; billing assume-role added."
deploybot: preflight running...
deploybot: preflight OK  plan succeeded for targeted modules. Provider pinned: aws v4.83.2 (lock sha: zxy987).
Carlos: Local plan command:```bash
cd infra/networking
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=prod.backend
terraform plan -out=plan-1745 -var-file=prod.tfvars
```
Jae: Staggered strategy: apply hub region (us-west-2) first, monitor 6m, then spokes in parallel (eu-west-1 + ap-northeast-1). Hold on auto-approve for spokes until I ack metrics.
Nina: Ops runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/peering-2024-05  follow rollback path B if route flaps occur.
Carlos: Noted. Will snapshot state to s3://infra-state-snaps/release-2024-05/$(date +%s).tfstate before apply and tag snapshot with commit SHA.
